partition_reassembly_evidence: Two public author adaptive/innate partitions have disjoint original cell IDs and exactly identical 30,000 native RNA gene IDs/symbols. Reunite unchanged raw.X rows before SCimilarity; author cell labels/embeddings are not used to construct expression geometry. Exact original donor_id plus timepoint define 67 observed source groups, 65 after excluding HDML/HDVO alternate-freezing controls. These are source donor/visit groups, not sequencing lanes, bulk samples, or globally proven unique draws. Clinical time fields agree within groups across partitions.

constants.source_identity_policy: Donor/timepoint groups from published cell metadata; original onset/hospital days retained. T0/T1 are not assigned common calendar intervals across donors.
constants.source_selection_policy: Original study combines sorted/enriched and unsorted PBMC material; original per-cell capture sorting provenance is not resolved by adaptive/innate author-label partitions. Composition and type coverage may reflect selection.
constants.source_exclusion_policy: Original GEO design excludes HDML/HDVO alternate-freezing samples. CHI014 technical control and SHD8 author-excluded donor are absent from these deposited atlas partitions; no new samples inferred.
constants.source_geometry_policy: Use unchanged native RNA counts, cell TP10K and cell log1p(TP10K) means. Native 30,000-gene deposited coverage retained; other source genes unavailable, not zero-filled.
constants.source_overlap_policy: GSE161918, HCA ae62bb31-55ca-4127-b0fb-b1771a604645 and CELLxGENE ed9185e3-5b82-40c7-9824-b2141590c7f0 are repository aliases. No completed exports found for these source records before this acquisition; global donor overlap unresolved.

source_metadata.access: Public processed human PBMC RNA count matrices; unrelated molecular modalities not acquired.
source_metadata.license: HCA project page states CC BY 4.0; preserve atlas and original publication attribution.
source_metadata.raw_count_location: Original raw.X in each atlas partition; source X normalized and omitted.
